CREATE PROCEDURE DW.SP_DW_DIMBRANCH_HISTORICAL
AS
BEGIN

WITH BranchSK AS (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(BranchSK),0) RN  from DW.DimBranch )

,Branch_AR AS (
    SELECT  DISTINCT
        BB.BranchId AS BranchID
        ,BB.BranchName AS BranchName
        ,NULL AS BranchDescription
        ,BBGD.BranchGroupDescription AS Area
        ,BB.FinancialInstitutionId AS BankSK
        ,BB.InsertDttm
    FROM BNKM.Branch BB
    LEFT JOIN BNKM.BranchGroupBranch BBGB ON  BB.BranchId = BBGB.BranchId 
    LEFT JOIN BNKM.BranchGroupDescription BBGD ON BBGB.BranchGroupId = BBGD.BranchGroupId
    where substring(BBGD.BranchGroupId,1,2) = 'AR')

, Branch_REG AS (
    SELECT  DISTINCT
    BB.BranchId AS BranchID
    ,BB.BranchName AS BranchName
    ,NULL AS BranchDescription
    ,BBGD.BranchGroupDescription AS Region
    ,BB.FinancialInstitutionId AS BankSK
    ,BB.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.Branch BB
LEFT JOIN BNKM.BranchGroupBranch BBGB ON  BB.BranchId = BBGB.BranchId 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.BranchGroupDescription BBGD ON BBGB.BranchGroupId = BBGD.BranchGroupId
where substring(BBGD.BranchGroupId,1,3) = 'REG')

,TEMP_DW_DIMBRANCH AS (
    SELECT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN  FROM BranchSK) AS BranchSK
        ,* 
    FROM ( 
        SELECT DISTINCT
            AR.BRANCHID
            ,AR.BranchName
            ,AR.BranchDescription
            ,AR.Area
            ,REG.Region
            ,AR.BankSK
            ,1 AS CurrentIndicator
            ,ISNULL(AR.InsertDttm,REG.InsertDttm) AS ValidStartDate
            ,LEAD(ISNULL(AR.InsertDttm,REG.InsertDttm),1,'9999-12-31') AS ValidEndDate
            ,0 AS WorkFlowId
            ,0 AS TaskRunId
            ,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
    FROM Branch_AR AR
    JOIN Branch_REG REG 
        ON AR.BranchID = REG.BranchID AND AR.BankSK = REG.BankSK
)A)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DIMBRANCH FROM TEMP_DW_DIMBRANCH;

INSERT INTO DW.DIMBRANCH
    (BranchSK
    ,BranchID
    ,BranchName
    ,BranchDescription
    ,Area
    ,Region
    ,BankSK
    ,CurrentIndicator
    ,ValidStartDate
    ,ValidEndDate
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm)
SELECT
    BranchSK
    ,SRC.BranchID
    ,BranchName
    ,BranchDescription
    ,Area
    ,Region
    ,SRC.BankSK
    ,CurrentIndicator
    ,ValidStartDate
    ,ValidEndDate
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_DW_DIMBRANCH

END
